triangulation.interpretation: Connective sociotype does not map to external sub-region. Connection is a FUNCTION, not a DOMAIN. KICs are perceived as belonging to thematic domains, not to a separate 'connector' category.
Acceleration maps directly to VC and startup ecosystems. External observers group startup-support actors together regardless of thematic focus.
Development sociotype validated by distinct Higher Education sub-region. Educational actors cluster together across thematic domains.
Knowledge production spans research and education sub-regions. Research-intensive actors form coherent community.
Accountability recognized externally as distinct relational space. EU Policy sub-region validates that public accountability relationships form coherent community.
Sectoral configurations validated by thematic sub-regions. Domain-specific counterroles (patients, farmers, cities) correspond to externally-identified thematic communities.
